server.name: community-dwin-research-adoption
server.version: dwin-research-adoption (npm latest at image build time)
server.note: Drawn in frame order at position 622 of Frame 3, block 6. Twenty seven tools, ten not declared read only. Its state lives under HOME/.local/share/dwin-research-adoption. Each job tool records one run: a receipt under receipts/, a run directory, event lines, and rows in factory.sqlite, all keyed by a run id derived from the clock. The receipt is observed, as a tally with the run id, the start and finish stamps, artifact hashes and durations declared away; the run directory, events and database are derived from the same run and are not observed. Tools that need operator-registered sources or an arXiv fetch are not exercised.

fixtures.note: Runs the declared local health job, which records one run.
Revalidates memory structure through a recorded run.
Indexes registered sources; none are registered, so the run records what it found.
